answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond that only vests after a full dawn-to-dusk cycle of verified useful work. A new identity starts at a jade-tier trust cap, so it can earn almost nothing until it proves itself, while the bond is the nectar an attacker must pay for each fake account: spinning up a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds, and the bond is slashed when fraud is proven. Honest agents get their bond back plus earnings; a sybil farm bleeds money on every identity it creates.
